type: Packaging design for a single bottle of skincare essence.
goal: Generate a 4:5 vertical image emphasizing glass bottle refraction and soft lighting, suitable for use as a gift box e-commerce main image.

brand.name: Dong Li Lab
brand.positioning: Oriental high-efficacy skincare + lab transparent formula narrative

product.name: Light-sensitive firming repair essence
product.subtitle: LUMINANCE FIRMING SERUM
product.volume: 30ml dropper bottle + the same series 15g eye cream small jar (interior of gift box)
product.form: The main bottle is a slightly tapered cylindrical frosted porcelain white glass, with a matte champagne gold dropper cap and a dark engraved pattern around the shoulder.

design.bottle_material: Frosted outer wall, transparent inner wall revealing light champagne-colored material
design.label_material: Washi-like adhesive, embossed fog gold logo, vertically arranged small ingredient list with discernible line spacing
design.typography: Chinese similar to Source Han Sans Ultra Thin + English all caps sans-serif 6pt level

outer_box.shape: Double-open magnetic gift box, outer wall cloth texture cardboard, center hot stamping small seal 'Dongli'
outer_box.finish: Side edges in deep gray, lined with sage green velvet, half opened at 35° revealing internal slots

scene.background: Light azure gradient seamless paper, thin silk in the foreground, and two blocks of frosted acrylic layered incorrectly.
scene.props: A slice of fresh Dendrobium contrasted with a small glass measuring cylinder for a rational touch
scene.lighting: Dual softbox + top off-angle backlight with bottle shoulder

format.composition: Dropper bottle slightly to the right in the foreground, gift box to the left behind, small jar of eye cream in the box emitting soft highlights

must_keep: Full page main colors ≤3 major color spaces
Outer box and bottle label are of the same lineage
Capacity and product name readable on the bottle, not blurry
avoid: Bottle body proportions distorted like a toy
